title: WALTEUR Release Readiness
description: Pre-promotion readiness record for a release artifact: signed and SBOM'd provenance, an explicit deploy strategy, a non-empty rehearsed rollback command, an automated promotion gate, and reversible migrations.

artifact_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the release artifact (e.g. sha256:...).

signature_verified.description: True iff the artifact's cryptographic signature has been verified.

sbom_path.description: Path or URI to the Software Bill of Materials for the artifact.

provenance_slsa_level.description: SLSA provenance level of the build (0 = none, 1-4 per SLSA spec).

deploy_strategy.description: How the release is rolled out.

rollback_command.description: Exact command that reverts the deployment. Must be non-empty.

rollback_rehearsed.description: True iff the rollback_command has actually been executed/rehearsed in a non-prod or game-day setting.

metric.description: Metric that gates promotion (e.g. error_rate, p99_latency_ms).

threshold.description: Threshold value the metric must satisfy to allow promotion.

auto_rollback.description: True iff breaching the threshold triggers an automatic rollback.

migration_reversible.description: True iff every schema/data migration in this release has a tested down-path.
